description: This file defines an interface for password hashing within the Conduit project's security infrastructure, specifying a method for asynchronously hashing passwords with a salt.

classes.name: IPasswordHasher
classes.description: An interface that mandates a method for hashing passwords asynchronously, and also extends IDisposable for resource cleanup.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password using a provided salt, returning a byte array of the hashed data.
